cards.front: ¡Dímelo!
cards.back: Tell me!

cards.front: ¡Díselo a él!
cards.back: Tell him!

cards.front: ¡Díselo a ellos!
cards.back: Tell them!

cards.front: ¡Te lo estoy diciendo!
cards.back: I'm telling you!

cards.front: ¿Me lo vas a decir?
cards.back: Are you going to tell me?

cards.front: No quiero decírtelo.
cards.back: I don't want to tell you.

cards.front: ¡Ni se te ocurra decírselo a ellos!
cards.back: Don't even think about telling them!

cards.front: ¡Ni se te ocurra decírselo a ella!
cards.back: Don't even think about telling her!

cards.front: ¡Ni se os ocurra decírnoslo!
cards.back: Don't even think about telling us!

cards.front: Se lo diré a ellas cuando me pidan perdón.
cards.back: I'll tell them when they say sorry to me.

cards.front: No te lo diré mientras no me pidas perdón.
cards.back: I won't tell you unless you say sorry to me.

cards.front: No se lo diré a ella hasta que me pida perdón.
cards.back: I won't tell her until she says sorry to me.

cards.front: ¿Me lo dirás si friego para ti?
cards.back: Will you tell me if I do the dishes for you?

cards.front: ¿Me lo dirás si te hago la compra?
cards.back: Will you tell me if I do the shopping for you?

cards.front: ¿Me lo dirás si te hago la cama?
cards.back: Will you tell me if I make the bed for you?

cards.front: Dime que puedes hacerlo.
cards.back: Tell me you can do it.

cards.front: Dime que lo harás.
cards.back: Tell me you'll do it.

cards.front: ¿Me estás diciendo que no puedes ir?
cards.back: Are you telling me you can't go?

cards.front: Por favor, dile que está invitado.
cards.back: Please tell him he's invited.

cards.front: No le digas que no está invitado.
cards.back: Don't tell him he isn't invited.

cards.front: Si le dices que no está invitado, se enfadará.
cards.back: If you tell him he isn't invited, he'll get angry.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no le dices a ella que no está invitada?
cards.back: Why don't you tell her she's not invited?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no les dices que no pueden ir?
cards.back: Why don't you tell them they can't go?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no les dices que no están invitados a la reunión?
cards.back: Why don't you tell them they aren't invited to the meeting?

cards.front: ¿Por qué ella no le dice a él que puede venir en diciembre?
cards.back: Why doesn't she tell him he can come in December?

cards.front: ¿Por qué él no le dice a ella que no puede venir antes de diciembre?
cards.back: Why doesn't he tell her she can't come before December?

cards.front: ¿Por qué ella no les dice que pueden volver en diciembre?
cards.back: Why doesn't she tell them they can come back in December?

cards.front: Dile que bajo ninguna circunstancia voy a invitar a su mujer a mi fiesta de cumpleaños.
cards.back: Tell him there's no way I'm going to invite his wife to my birthday party.

cards.front: ¿Me estás diciendo que no hay manera de que lleve a mi mujer?
cards.back: Are you telling me there's no way I can take my wife?

cards.front: Te estoy diciendo que no hay manera de que lo hagamos antes de diciembre.
cards.back: I'm telling you there's no way we can do it before December.

cards.front: Dime lo que quieres.
cards.back: Tell me what you want.

cards.front: Dinos lo que hace.
cards.back: Tell us what it does.

cards.front: Diles lo que sabes.
cards.back: Tell them what you know.

cards.front: Diles lo que está haciendo tu amiga en Japón.
cards.back: Tell them what your friend's doing in Japan.

cards.front: ¿Me puedes decir lo que están diciendo?
cards.back: Can you tell me what they're saying?

cards.front: ¿Me puedes decir qué estás diciendo?
cards.back: Can you tell me what you're talking about?

cards.front: Dime lo que vais a hacer la semana que viene.
cards.back: Tell me what you're going to do next week.

cards.front: Diles lo que vamos a preparar para la cena de esta noche.
cards.back: Tell them what we're going to make for dinner tonight.

cards.front: ¿Les puedes decir lo que va a hacer el presidente?
cards.back: Can you tell them what the President's going to do?

cards.front: Explícamelo.
cards.back: Explain it to me.

cards.front: ¿Me lo puedes explicar?
cards.back: Can you explain it to me?

cards.front: Quiero que me lo expliques.
cards.back: I want you to explain it to me.

cards.front: Explícame lo que hace esta máquina.
cards.back: Explain to me what this machine does.

cards.front: Explícanos lo que quieres decir.
cards.back: Explain to us what you mean.

cards.front: ¿Me puedes explicar lo que están haciendo aquellos hombres?
cards.back: Can you explain to me what those men are doing?

cards.front: ¡Cuéntales!
cards.back: Tell them!

cards.front: ¡Cuéntaselo a ellos!
cards.back: Tell them about it!

cards.front: ¡Cuéntamelo!
cards.back: Tell me about it!

cards.front: Cuéntame algo de tus vacaciones.
cards.back: Tell me something about your holiday.

cards.front: ¿Me puedes contar algo acerca de tu pueblo?
cards.back: Can you tell me something about your hometown?

cards.front: Si te cuento algo acerca de mi niñez, ¿me contarás algo sobre la tuya?
cards.back: If I tell you something about my childhood, will you tell me something about yours?

cards.front: No quiero contártelo.
cards.back: I don't want to tell you about it.

cards.front: ¿Por qué no quieres contármelo?
cards.back: Why don't you want to tell me about it?

cards.front: Te lo contaré mañana por la mañana.
cards.back: I'll tell you about it tomorrow morning.

cards.front: Cuéntanos qué tipo de comida te gusta.
cards.back: Tell us about what type of food you like.

cards.front: Cuéntanos qué tipo de piso estás buscando.
cards.back: Tell us about what type of flat you're looking for.

cards.front: Cuéntanos qué tipo de coche quieres comprar.
cards.back: Tell us about what type of car you want to buy.

cards.front: Cuéntanos qué tipo de cosas te gusta hacer el fin de semana.
cards.back: Tell us about what sort of things you like doing on the weekend.

cards.front: ¿Les puedes contar qué tipo de ordenador quieres comprar?
cards.back: Can you tell them about what sort of computer you want to get?

cards.front: Cuéntale a ella qué tipo de persona estás buscando.
cards.back: Tell her about what sort of person you're looking for.

cards.front: Dile a él que se calle, por favor.
cards.back: Tell him to be quiet, please.

cards.front: Diles que se callen, por favor.
cards.back: Tell them to shut up, please.

cards.front: Diles que bajen el volumen un poco, por favor.
cards.back: Tell them to keep the noise down, please.

cards.front: Siempre les digo a mis hijos que sean silenciosos por las mañanas.
cards.back: I always tell my children to be quiet in the mornings.

cards.front: A veces mi vecina les dice a sus hijos que se callen.
cards.back: My neighbour sometimes tells her children to shut up.

cards.front: Si los niños hacen mucho ruido, les diré que bajen un poco el volumen.
cards.back: If the children make a lot of noise, I'll tell them to keep the noise down.

cards.front: Dicho de otro modo, te estoy diciendo que trabajes.
cards.back: In other words, I'm telling you to do some work.

cards.front: Dicho de otro modo, te estoy diciendo que te calles.
cards.back: In other words, I'm telling you to be quiet.

cards.front: Dicho de otro modo, estoy diciéndote que pares.
cards.back: In other words, I'm telling you to stop.

cards.front: Dile que te cuente su experiencia.
cards.back: Tell him to tell you about his experience.

cards.front: ¿Les puedes decir que me cuenten su experiencia?
cards.back: Can you tell them to tell me about their experience?

cards.front: ¿Por qué no le dices a ella que te cuente su experiencia en la India?
cards.back: Why don't you tell her to tell you about her experience in India?

cards.front: Quiero que le digas que vaya al supermercado para mí.
cards.back: I want you to tell him to go to the supermarket for me.

cards.front: ¿Quieres que yo les diga que nos echen una mano?
cards.back: Do you want me to tell them to give us a hand?

cards.front: ¿Quiere él que yo les diga que vengan a la reunión?
cards.back: Does he want me to tell them to come to the meeting?

cards.front: Dile a él que no vaya allí; es peligroso.
cards.back: Tell him not to go there; it's dangerous.

cards.front: Dile a él que no hable con esa gente; son peligrosos.
cards.back: Tell him not to speak to those people; they're dangerous.

cards.front: Diles que no compren esa moto; es peligrosa.
cards.back: Tell them not to buy that motorbike; it's dangerous.

cards.front: Diles a esos hombres que bajen un poco el volumen, por favor.
cards.back: Tell those men to keep the noise down, please.

cards.front: Dile a ella que no se acerque a esos hombres; son peligrosos.
cards.back: Tell her not to go near those men; they're dangerous.

cards.front: Diles a esos hombres que no se acerquen al borde; es peligroso.
cards.back: Tell those men not to go near the edge; it's dangerous.

cards.front: Dile a esa mujer que no hable con aquellas señoras.
cards.back: Tell that woman not to speak to those women.

cards.front: Diles a esas mujeres que no hablen con aquella mujer.
cards.back: Tell those women not to speak to that woman.

cards.front: ¿Les puedes decir a esos hombres que no se acerquen a esas mujeres?
cards.back: Can you tell those men not to go near those women?

cards.front: No le puedo decir a ella que no haga un esfuerzo.
cards.back: I can't tell her not to make an effort.

cards.front: No te estoy diciendo que no hagas un esfuerzo.
cards.back: I'm not telling you not to make an effort.

cards.front: ¿Por qué me estás diciendo que no haga un esfuerzo?
cards.back: Why are you telling me not to make an effort?

cards.front: Quiero que le digas a ella que le diga a él que haga un esfuerzo.
cards.back: I want you to tell her to tell him to make an effort.

cards.front: ¿Quieres que yo le diga a él que les diga a ellos que hagan un esfuerzo?
cards.back: Do you want me to tell him to tell them to make an effort?

cards.front: No sé si quiero que le digas a él que le diga a ella que haga un esfuerzo o no.
cards.back: I don't know if I want you to tell him to tell her to make an effort or not.
